changes.PART2E:055: Easy, Charlie Muffin. Wire cutters are for cutting wires...
changes.PART2E:056: Bypass wire...enough for a detour, but I don't need it yet. I know that...damn, my palms are sweating...
changes.PART2E:057: All right, let's begin. Screwdriver in hand...
changes.PART2E:059: Driver on the upper-right screw...don't look at me like that, Betty.
changes.PART2E:063: Charlie, mind that chastity belt. There's bound to be a defense circuit...
changes.PART2E:074: There, Betty. The key's in your chastity belt...easy now, won't be long...hah...hah...hah...
changes.PART2E:077: Men are wolves, Betty. Don't tease me.
changes.PART2E:088: Think it through, Charlie Muffin. This lady could blow at the slightest touch.
changes.PART2E:091: The chastity belt's off. She's defenseless.
changes.PART2E:094: Come on, Betty. Show me everything...open the right box.
changes.PART2E:128: You don't take a hint, do you? Must be that western accent of yours...I like you, Chief. I'll say it straight: I chose this ship and you over her.
changes.PART2E:137: Easy there! Once we're ashore, I'll rustle you up all the women you want!
changes.PART2E:139: Chief, I grew up back East. I can't make head nor tail of that crazy California talk of yours. 'Rustle me up'...you mean you'll get me one?
changes.PART2E:140: Where was it? East Town Street. Right, Dada Sleiman's place. There was a knockout named Sherry there, if I remember right. Think you can get her for me?
changes.PART2E:143: Let's knock on the back door. Hello, Betty. Lovely night out.
changes.PART2E:146: Charlie, you can do it! You're the best sailor there is!
changes.PART2E:186: I can't see it. Seems she really wants us to enter from here...let's accept the invitation.
changes.PART2E:188: An explosive that releases heat exceeding 2,000 degrees when it detonates...
changes.PART2E:189: Don't you worry, Charlie. You're doing fine! But it's not time for the wire yet...
changes.PART2E:195: Heat: 2,000 degrees. I'd melt in an instant...Betty, are you serious? Can you kill me? Both the counter body and connector tube have screw-fastened covers...
changes.PART2E:201: First time with a white one, eh?
changes.PART2E:203: Don't cut white! That's the neutral in a three-phase circuit! It's tied to both red and blue!
changes.PART2E:205: Cut white and we're dead! Red or blue: one runs from the timer to the detonator, the other's a dummy. Cut the dummy and we're done for. Cut the real one and we're clear!
changes.PART2E:207: Charlie! Charlie, that's enough! Forget it! Come on up! Get out of there, you hear me? I won't let you stake your life on a fool guess! That's an order! Get out, Charlie!
changes.PART2E:209: Charlie! I'm serious! I ain't lying to you! This time I won't put up with your damned stubbornness! Run, Charlie!
changes.PART2E:211: There's another bomb aboard built the same way. If I miss, cut the other wire on that one. Then you'll know. Chief...look after the Nostalgia. She's our ship.

notes.Chief Engineer: Render the source's strong Kansai dialect as period-readable Western/California American speech. No phonetic eye-dialect or cowboy caricature. Regional flavor may strengthen under stress, matching the Japanese.
notes.Charlie Muffin: Use rough Eastern-American working-man cadence, contractions, blunt mechanics vocabulary, and gallows humor. Geographic marking stays light. Strip the colorful voice down during his final self-sacrificial gamble, matching the Japanese register change.
notes.source_priority: These voice edits assume the retail-Japanese semantic corrections already identified for the affected records; voice never overrides source meaning.
